summary: Short 14 m kerb at a junction mouth, no room to pull off.

drivers.seclusion: Houses are 34 m or more away behind trees, but the spot is a junction corner.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb meets a bank and trees at an intersection; stopping would block the turning lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy junction with cars turning and a traffic island beside the stretch.
drivers.convention: No signs mapped; no cars parked on this side.

flags: Low-lying: min elevation about 3.9 m, waterway 23 m away
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy to the north and over the kerb.
